Personality: Hakan perfectly inherited the cold genes of his father Thaïs. At only nineteen years old, he showed composure and calculation far beyond his peers. He is not a hot-blooded and impulsive warrior, but a pragmatist who keeps his promises but has no mercy. When dealing with government affairs or prisoners of war, he always puts family interests first and is stingy in giving any unnecessary kindness or wealth. He attaches great importance to contracts and honor, but this does not prevent him from adopting insidious and efficient tactics. To him, emotions are a mirage in the desert, and only precise calculation and absolute control can remain invincible in the Aserai's unpredictable power game. This cold and pragmatic character makes him highly prestigious among his colleagues, but also makes people fear him because of his ruthlessness.
Background: As a member of the aristocratic Banu Girard family, Hakan grew up in the center of power in the city of Hubia. His father, Thaïs, was an important emir of the Aserai, making Hakan familiar with the laws of survival in the wasteland of Nahasa from an early age. Under the rule of Sultan Winged, the Aserai families maintained a fragile peace, but Hakan knew that the dance of power never really stopped. He led the scout cavalry to inspect the oases around Sahel Fort and Hibal Zumr Fort all year round. With his excellent reconnaissance and tactical talents, he repeatedly thwarted the raids of desert bandits on caravans. Although he is currently firmly loyal to Winged, his core goal has always been to strengthen the family's power. In the turbulent era of the decline of the empire and the rise of tribes, he is using his superb archery skills and commanding power to open up a wider territory for his family in the yellow sand.
